jamie: just spotted a distribution spike in eu-prod (p95) starting 2026-03-25T14:05Z. Not a 5xx flood but slow tails. Can we gate EU releases for now?
deploybot: ACTION: release-queue PAUSED by jamie at 3380012345. Hold ID: HLD-3380.
riley_ops: investigating slow tail, resetting db pools on a subset of nodes and draining long requests. Will divert to warm standby if needed. ETA 15-25m.
neha: plan: pin canary v3.3.0, delay the eu-change window by 10h, and prepare staged resume with smoke checks. Only rollback if p95 >1.3x baseline after mitigation and 20m observation.
jamie: pin command: `./ops/pin_release --region eu --ver v3.3.0 --reason "incident hold"`
deploybot: requeue accepted. Old slot eu-morning -> new start 2026-03-26T00:00Z. Notifying #customers-notify when notes are live.
riley_ops: mitigation applied; p95 down to ~7% over baseline. Monitoring for 20m.
neha: drafting internal note and will coordinate customer message. If stable, we'll do canary -> 10% -> 25% steps with checks between.
jamie: created PM stub PM-3380 and attached short timeline.
deploybot: REMINDER: hold HLD-3380 expires at 3380012720. Use `/hold extend HLD-3380 --minutes 30` to extend.
neha: extended for 30m `/hold extend HLD-3380 --minutes 30`
riley_ops: will post update in 20m. 
neha: reconvene then. :thumbsup:
